scientific_integrity: All stated Smith normal forms were calculated with exact integers. A second clique-complex and finite-field implementation reproduced the complete class index set and the sparse witness. A concrete integral chain certificate is provided. Independent external validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact exhaustive classification is restricted to finite undirected simple graphs with at most seven original graph vertices. No homotopy classification is claimed; completeness of unlabeled graph representatives relies on the published Graph Atlas.
title: Sharp edge threshold for torsion in matching complexes of seven-vertex graphs
